This catalog contains all 164 prompt bodies in 31 categories (163 numbered entries).
Original prompt bodies, stable IDs, declared metadata, author and source references
are exported using the existing GalleryMarkdownParser. Chinese category labels and
search keywords are editorial translations, separate from original prompt tags.
The parser normalizes CRLF to LF and removes enclosing fence/outer whitespace.
Individual author and source references are retained from the upstream documents;
the repository license notice does not replace those attribution markers.
Upstream preview images are not distributed or fetched by this export.
